title: Manhattan for Nutmeg: The Trade of Run Island
summary: Set in the century when nutmeg grew only in the Banda Islands, this episode tells how the Dutch East India Company emptied those islands in sixteen twenty-one to seize the monopoly, and how England handed the tiny island of Run over to the Dutch in exchange for Manhattan under the Treaty of Breda in sixteen sixty-seven. The episode ranges from Nathaniel Courthope's four years of resistance to Jan Pieterszoon Coen's massacre, and from the Raid on the Medway to the smuggling of nutmeg seedlings that brought the monopoly down.
